pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Edges exhibit a soft pixel gradient transitioning from dark brown to light beige. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank, decreasing in area towards the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space separating dark patches. Pathways are of relatively uniform pixel width with clearly defined three-way and four-way junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, low-amplitude serrated fringe visible along the dorsal neck line against the background, appearing as a continuous high-frequency textural edge.
